body: Clash C. Finding 36: opposite = reversed on one axis; inverse = reversed on two. 'Inversion' already names the Inversion Log, the inversion section of cross-pollination intake and a verdict vocabulary (Campaign A). Read back as the option 'Qualify the new one: call the doc's meaning a two-axis inverse; the Inversion Log keeps the plain word.' JayArr chose it, 2026-10-11.
plain: The doc's 'inverse' (reversed on two axes) is called a 'two-axis inverse'. The Inversion Log keeps the plain word.
